issue_context.title: UserSecrets should reload on changed
issue_context.body:
Today the host will reload appsettings.json if it changes.
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/4b8c5fe2b4757f77f5699d49a072fcb123d2e33b/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/Host.cs#L74-L77

However, it does not reload the user secrets file.
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/4b8c5fe2b4757f77f5699d49a072fcb123d2e33b/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/Host.cs#L84
See
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/4b8c5fe2b4757f77f5699d49a072fcb123d2e33b/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets/src/UserSecretsConfigurationExtensions.cs#L119

These are similar resources and should have similar functionality.

review_comments: One more thought, would we want this test to be flagged [outerloop](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/project/writing-tests.md#outerloop) since this adds delay?
I am not sure about this, so decision is up to you. If you decide to mark it with `[OuterLoop]`, make sense to mark two other tests with delay too and to do it in separated PR

The test above this does the same thing. The delay is only a "timeout" in case the `configReloadedCancelToken` never fires. The test will take much less time than a minute to execute under normal circumstances.

Afaik assembly must have this attribute
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/6072e4d3a7a2a1493f514cdf4be75a3d56580e84/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets/src/UserSecretsConfigurationExtensions.cs#L131-L135

Got it. Yes that appears that's the only way Hosting will hook up UserSecrets:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/eb187d1250cf65c16442c207ff97da65690afae5/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/Host.cs#L81-L84
